We each put in a 10-chip ante, so the pot is 20 and you're at 990. You're holding K♥ Q♥, which is a strong start. It's your move. You Check, or call if there is a bet. The flop is J♠ 7♥ 2♣. You haven't made a pair yet, and your highest card is the king. A queen or king would give you a pair, and a ten would give you a straight. It's your move. You Bet 50. You bet 50 and the dealer called, so the pot is 160 and you're at 920. The turn is 4♦, so the board is J♠ 7♥ 2♣ 4♦. You still don't have a pair, and your highest card is the king. You have one card left to come. A king or queen would give you a pair, and a ten would give you a straight. It's your move. You Check, or call if there is a bet. The river card is 5♠, so the board is J♠ 7♥ 2♣ 4♦ 5♠. You missed: you don't have a pair or a straight, and your best hand is king high. This is the last betting round before showdown. You can check, bet to try to make the dealer fold, or fold. It's your move. You Check, or call if there is a bet. You checked, and the dealer checked too, so it went to showdown. The dealer had 9♣ 9♦, a pair of nines, which beats your king high. The dealer takes the 260-chip pot. You put in 130 chips this round, so you lost 130 and you're at 870. Round 2. We each put in a 10-chip ante, so the pot is 20 and you're at 860. Your hole cards are A♠ 8♦. You have the ace, but the 8 is a weak second card. It's your move before the flop. You Fold. You folded, so the dealer takes the pot. You lose 10 and stay at 860. Round 3. We each put in a 10-chip ante, so the pot is 20 and you're at 850. Your hole cards are 7♣ 7♥, a pair of sevens before any shared cards come out. That's a solid start. It's your move before the flop. You Raise 100. The dealer folds to your bet of 100. You take the pot and win 10 chips, so you're at 870. You Check, or call if there is a bet. Round 3 is already over. The dealer folded and you won 10 chips, so there was no bet to check or call. I've dealt Round 4 so you can look at your cards first. You and the dealer each put in a 10-chip ante, so the pot is 20 and your bankroll is 860. You're holding K♥ J♣, which is two high cards and a good start. It's your move before the flop.
